Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: An active HEMA fighter who trains weekly, values historical accuracy (Liechtenauer, Fiore, Meyer), and takes pride in their specific weapon discipline (Longsword, Rapier, Dussack).
product_angles: Historical Fechtbuch-style training and sparring logbook (KDP)
3D printable wall mounts and modular racks for Federschwerter / training swords (Cults3D)
Vector SVG packs of historical fencing stances and guard postures for custom guild shirts (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Sparring and Technique Journal with custom interior template pages for recording bout outcomes and technique drills

proposals.name: Modular Sci-Fi Hex Terrain (Wargaming & Battletech)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop wargamers (especially Battletech and hex-based RPG players) who own 3D printers and want cheap, modular, scalable sci-fi terrain that fits standard 1.25-inch or 2-inch hex grids.
product_angles: Parametric 3D-printable sci-fi hex hills, craters, and industrial barricades (Cults3D)
Laser-cut MDF terrain patterns and acrylic token vectors (Etsy)
Hex grid mapping notebooks for scenario design (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 5 parametric, stackable sci-fi hex hills optimized for supportless FDM printing

proposals.name: Arborists & Professional Tree Climbers
proposals.buyer_persona: Professional tree care technicians and climbers who are highly passionate about rigging physics, safety gear, tree biology, and the physical danger of their daily job.
product_angles: Arborist daily rigging calculations and equipment safety inspection logbook (KDP)
Vector SVG pack of precise climbing knot diagrams and tree rigging setups (Etsy)
Humorous 'Rigging is just math in the air' POD apparel (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: Arborist Daily Work Log & Rigging Safety Checklist Book (KDP)

proposals.name: Software Defined Radio (SDR) & Signal Hunters
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech hobbyists, ham radio operators, and cyber-security enthusiasts who use cheap SDR dongles (like RTL-SDR) to scan the RF spectrum, decode weather satellites, or track aircraft.
product_angles: Frequency spectrum coordinator and signal hunting logbook (KDP)
3D printable snap-fit enclosures and antenna mounts for RTL-SDR boards (Cults3D)
RF waterfall diagram aesthetic poster art and stickers (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: SDR Signal Hunter's Logbook for recording frequencies, modes, decibels, and coordinates (KDP)

proposals.name: Local Craft Breweries (French B2B / Micro-brasseries)
proposals.buyer_persona: Independent craft brewery owners in France looking for inexpensive, customizable marketing templates, tasting room assets, or production logbooks.
product_angles: Cellar master batch brewing logbook with French regulatory tracking helpers (KDP)
3D printable custom tasting flight paddles and tap handles (Cults3D)
Local hops and botanical vector SVG illustration packs for label design (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Botanical Hops and Yeast Vector SVG Pack with vintage hand-drawn styling for craft beer labels

proposals.name: Acoustic Engineers & Home Studio Designers
proposals.buyer_persona: Acousticians, audiophiles, and bedroom producers obsessed with frequency response curves, room modes, RT60 decay times, and physical acoustic treatment placement.
product_angles: Room impulse response measurement and acoustic calibration logbook (KDP)
Humorous room-mode and phase-cancellation visual diagram posters (Redbubble)
3D-printable mathematical calculation template tools for DIY skyline diffusers (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: Acoustic Measurement & Studio Calibration Logbook for tracking speaker placement and room treatment improvements (KDP)
